summary: Your current results show your strongest signals in the capstone (CSE3CAP) around Industry Standards and Project Management. The clearest area to focus on is Data Structures and Algorithms, which is a persistent gap, followed by consolidating your object-oriented foundations. These are formative signals to guide study, not a final judgement on your ability. Practise the algorithms skills alongside the OO foundations they build on.

priorities.evidence: This is your lowest attainment at 48.9% and a persistent gap, with CSE2ALG at 48.0% (CSE1OOF 52.6%). Your CSE2ALG:Central examination (47.0%), CSE2ALG:Assignment (49.0%) and CSE2ALG:Test (49.0%) all sit in the limited range, and markers flagged gaps in identifying, implementing and comparing data structures and sorting/searching algorithms in Java.
priorities.actions: Revisit the CSE2ALG:Central examination and CSE2ALG:Assignment feedback and re-attempt the tasks in smaller, well-tested pieces as the marker advised. Practise implementing searching and sorting algorithms in Java (CSE2ALG:SILO3), then explicitly compare their performance and justify a choice for a given problem (CSE2ALG:SILO4, CSE2ALG:SILO5). Anchor this by re-reviewing encapsulation and abstract data types from CSE1OOF:SILO2, which underpins clean data structure implementations.
